role: Declares the empty value type `OvernightStreamingCoordinator` (holds RRCollector strongly); its behaviour lives in extensions in RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.swift and RRCollector+OvernightArming.swift. The morning gather is not on this type (the doc comment says so): gatherOvernightData is an extension of MorningSessionPipeline (RRCollector+OvernightGather.swift:12,20) that only uses this type's nested OvernightDataResult and static hasSufficientOvernightData. Built by `RRCollector.overnightStreaming` (RRCollector+OvernightStreamingForwarding.swift:14).
types: OvernightStreamingCoordinator: struct (@MainActor) — transient handle for overnight-streaming extensions
